intro: Joys of Omosh is a heartwarming closing moment between the blacksmith Orokk Omosh and an adventurer who has helped him in Orgrimmar. Moved to tears, the veteran smith insists that soot is just in his eye before demonstrating a cherished family tradition. By performing the vigorous Omosh dance of joy, he passes down an unusual bit of family heritage.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Orokk is not crying, friend. Soot is in eye.
There is one last Omosh family secret Orokk will teach you. Orokk will die happy, thanks to friend.
Learn Omosh dance of joy and then you learn fist of iron!

clips.title: Completion
paras: It has been a very long time since Orokk has done the Omosh dance of joy. Learn now, friend!
